name: How long does it typically take to complete a garage conversion ADU?
description: A garage conversion ADU can take several months to over half a year, influenced by design, permitting, and construction complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a garage conversion ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion ADU can range from a few months to over half a year, depending on the project's complexity, the speed of permit approvals, and the availability of materials and labor. Design and permitting alone can take several weeks or months. Construction then follows, which involves demolition, framing, utility installation, and finishing work. Hometelligent Inc. works to streamline the process, but the overall schedule is also influenced by the homeowner's timely decisions on design and material selections.
